additional_info.subject: ID0371129-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R8 170002509] SECC_DC2_MB_Problem_KF11 CRM:00642001355
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing great.
As we received case from an end customer, we
found the error
"SECC_KF11_GenData_MB_Problem" and "DC2_CableTempSensorXD101".
Kindly check following points which we have mentioned-
Regarding error"SECC_DC2_MB_Problem_KF11".
Check if SECC2300 of dispenser is available & connected
Restart the SECC,
usually this solves this problem.
Basically error "SECC_DC2_MB_Problem" indicates the Modbus connection problem. Checked the cables and connections. We can try rebooting only the SECC once. If still issue persists then we try to be replacing the SECC.
And regarding error "
DC2_CableTempSensorXD101
", please check the resistance between P1 - P2 and N1 - N2, attached the screenshot below for reference. It should be same/near the value mentioned in the PT1000 temperature value chart attached below for your reference.
For example, if we assume the temperature of Pt1000 as 30 degC, the value should be 1116.70 Ohms between the P1-P2 and N1-N2.
Resistance chart:
PT1000 resistance table
